answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy needs a stake-backed identity kernel: every agent registers one bonded identity in a shared atlas that maps public keys to locked collateral, and any agent caught running duplicate identities loses its stake. Independent watchers, call one Raven, continuously cross-check behavior fingerprints against the atlas, so a single operator spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand separate bonds. The cost of faking scales linearly while the reward stays flat, which makes mass sock-puppeting unprofitable by construction.
